summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test of Spanish Hub guest mode. Login -> guest -> home -> all 15 drill cards launched and exercised, My Words search/category modal/word-detail/add+delete custom word, Leaderboard tabs + guest banner, Daily goal modal save, mode filters, sign-out -> back to login. All requested data-testids found and interactive. Matching game completes successfully (6/6) when paired sequentially. Flashcard, Type ES->EN, Listen & Type drills all reach done screen. Spanish flag bar, terracotta plaster background, 660px centered container, Playfair Display serif headings, and glass-morphism card all render correctly.

design_issues.screen: Header tabs (My Words / Leaderboard inactive states)
issues: Inactive tab labels appear in light gray on light/white background — slightly low contrast vs WCAG AA. Active 'Drills' tab is fine.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="word-item-{es}" to clickable word rows in WordList.jsx (noun groups, phrases, custom rows, search results) so word-row clicks can be addressed deterministically by future tests. Currently only the word-detail modal exposes testids.
(Optional) Slightly darken inactive tab text color for better contrast on the soft cream background.
critical_code_review_comments: AddWordForm.handleAdd lowercases es/en before saving (WordList.jsx:41). The delete testid is delete-word-${w.es}, so any test/automation creating words must use lowercase ids. Documented behavior — not a bug, but worth noting in the test plan.

MatchingDrill renders matched tiles as disabled (good UX), but they remain in the DOM. Tests using [data-testid^="match-es-"] should filter on :not([disabled]). Game completes correctly to done screen.
SpanishHub.jsx is 419 lines — within limit but trending toward needing a split (auth/state/routing concerns mixed). Not urgent.

Firestore writes will silently fail in guest mode by design — leaderboard reads still execute and return network calls; ensure no console error spam in production (verified: minor warnings only, no errors).
test_credentials: None required — guest mode used for all flows.
seed_data_creation: Created and immediately deleted custom word 'testpalabra' as part of add-word flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 drill data-testids verified live: drill-card-{flashcard,es-en,en-es,type-es-en,type-en-es,conjugation,past-tense,gender,matching,hear-choose,listen-type,sent-build,fill-blank}. Drills that loop infinitely without correct answers (es-en, conj, past-tense, gender, hear-choose) will not reach done unless answers are correct — that's expected behavior, not a bug. To complete matching deterministically, click match-es-{w} then match-en-{w} sequentially; matched tiles remain disabled in DOM. Add-word lowercases input before saving. Word rows lack individual data-testids; click via text or div selector if testing detail modal.
rca of the issue: No bugs requiring RCA. App functions end-to-end in guest mode.
